subject: Acceptance & launch readiness: signature timing and onboarding slot
messages:
From: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.com>
To: Naomi Jacobs <naomi.jacobs@acme.com>
Cc: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-08-30T09:12:00Z
Subject: Acceptance & launch readiness: signature timing and onboarding slot

Hi Naomi —

Thanks again for the conversation this morning. Per our MAP review, I attached an updated Mutual_Action_Plan_v4.xlsx that folds in the shortened eval cadence and the proposed start date window we discussed. To keep us on track for an early-September deploy, we need a firm go/no-go on the order form and confirmation of the signing authority timing.

Key asks from Acme for the next 72 hours:
- Confirm procurement approver and whether DocuSign is acceptable (we have the order form ready).
- Confirm earliest available start date for onboarding (we've penciled in 2026-09-13 as the first full-week ramp).
- Any outstanding SOC2 evidence items procurement still needs (I attached the summary).

Attachment: Mutual_Action_Plan_v4.xlsx (spreadsheet)
Attachment: SOC2_evidence_summary.pdf (doc)

If it helps I can route the order form via DocuSign and set a signing window for Monday 9/6 to hit the 9/13 start. Thoughts?

—Dylan
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
(d) +1 415-555-0142
From: Naomi Jacobs <naomi.jacobs@acme.com>
To: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.com>
Cc: Tom Richards <tom.richards@acme.com>, procurements@acme.com
Date: 2026-08-30T11:07:00Z
Subject: Re: Acceptance & launch readiness: signature timing and onboarding slot

Dylan —

Thanks for the MAP and the SOC2 summary. Quick answers:
- Procurement prefers DocuSign, that works.
- Approver is VP of Procurement (Tom Richards). He is traveling but can sign the week of 9/6 if we get the order form in by 9/3.
- SOC2 looks good from our side; legal asked for an explicit data-retention clause in the order form — I can route the redline if needed.

Please send the final order form and I will chase Tom. 9/13 start date looks fine from ops.

—Naomi
Sr. Product Ops, Acme Corp

To: Naomi Jacobs <naomi.jacobs@acme.com>

Thanks Naomi — I'll push the order form and a clean redline that includes a clarified data-retention clause. Evelyn, can your team prepare the onboarding slot for 2026-09-13 and a shortened ramp (2-week) plan?

(attachment: Order_Form_ACME_Redwood_v2.pdf)

Date: 2026-08-31T10:45:00Z
Subject: Re: Acceptance & launch readiness: signature timing and onboarding slot

All —

We can hold the onboarding cohort for 2026-09-13 and scope a two-week high-touch ramp to production. Deliverables we'll need before day one:
- Signed order form + billing contact
- API keys / allowlist (procurement can send IP ranges)
- 2 sample prompts + evaluation metrics (we can import these into our onboarding harness)

I will prepare a one-page day-zero checklist and share by end of day 9/1. Laura, can you confirm CS engineer availability for the week of 9/13?

—Evelyn
Customer Success Manager, Redwood Inference
From: Tom Richards <tom.richards@acme.com>
To: procurements@acme.com, Naomi Jacobs <naomi.jacobs@acme.com>
Cc: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-09-01T13:22:00Z
Subject: Re: Order form for Redwood — redline and approver timing

Folks —

I've reviewed the order form. Legal's proposed change to data-retention is reasonable; procurement can accept the clause in section 8.b with the explicit 90-day retention window. We need the DocuSign packet updated and sent to me by 9/03 COB to keep the 9/06 signing window.

Please note I will be out 9/02–9/04 on site; I can sign immediately on 9/06 morning if everything is in DocuSign.

(attachment: redline_order_form.pdf)

—Tom Richards
VP, Procurement — Acme Corporation
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
To: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.com>, Naomi Jacobs <naomi.jacobs@acme.com>
Cc: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-09-02T16:45:00Z
Subject: Final: DocuSign sent and signing window confirmation

Naomi / Tom —

Thanks — I just uploaded the updated order form to DocuSign with the 90-day retention clause (per Tom's note) and opened a signing session that closes 9/06 17:00PT. DocuSign link: https://docusign.com/embedded-sign/abc123

Dylan, Evelyn, Laura — we have the green light to proceed with the onboarding cohort for week of 9/13 pending completed payment details. I'll confirm billing contact and invoice schedule once Tom completes signing.

Attachments: Order_Form_ACME_Redwood_v2.pdf (DocuSign packet)

—Rishi
Director, Sales Operations — Redwood Inference
